Class Camera

java.lang.Object
renderer.Camera
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class Camera extends Object implements Cloneable
Represents a pinhole camera in 3D space.

A camera is defined by its position and orthonormal basis vectors: forward (vTo), up (vUp) and right (vRight). It also stores view-plane size, distance, and resolution required to construct rays through pixels.
